description: At boot, read memory/dream.log from line 1 using Read tool. Reported the April 18 initialization entry (top of file) as the 'last entry', incorrectly flagging the dream cycle as not having run in 41 days. The file is append-only and 750 lines long — the actual last entry was May 27. Should have used tail via osascript or Read with offset to get the bottom of the file.
correction: Dream cycle is running correctly and logging correctly. Boot log check must use tail -N or Read with offset near EOF, not Read from line 1.
proposed_fix: Add rule to SYSTEM.md boot protocol: when checking dream.log, use osascript tail command rather than Read tool, since the file is append-only and grows unboundedly. Read tool default reads from line 1.
